design_brief_zh: 主卖点聚焦铝合金拉杆的可见结构证据，以三档调节和拉杆上的可折叠手机支架形成差异化细节故事；侧面四个挂钩与可折叠水杯架按实物位置展开，作为产品右侧的辅助功能证据，不抢占拉杆主焦点。PC画布2000×2000：文案严格位于左侧[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.10,0.38,0.80]，产品位于右侧[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]。标题放在左上约y=0.12，支持说明置于其下约y=0.23；细节1与三档伸缩状态的局部放大对应，置于约y=0.44；细节2与展开的手机支架特写对应，置于约y=0.58。右侧采用旅行箱后侧偏侧面的三分之四视角，拉杆升起，利用三个连续小型局部画面展示三档位置，并以另一处真实微距展示手机支架；四个侧挂钩和展开的水杯架保持清楚可辨。移动端1200×1200需独立重排：产品及细节场景位于上方[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，底部文案位于[0.05,0.64,0.90,0.31]，阅读顺序固定为标题、支持说明、细节1、细节2，避免引导线穿过文字。背景采用低饱和欧洲现代旅行场景，以柔和自然侧光突出铝合金拉杆的金属质感、箱体竖条纹和部件边缘；整体为银灰、枪灰与深蓝中性色，橙色仅用于后期小面积信息强调。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线体，标题加粗，正文常规字重，德语区保留约20%扩展空间。资料未提供铝合金牌号、挂钩与杯架承重、手机兼容尺寸及可核对的部件尺寸，因此不得通过画面或文案暗示这些信息；若缺少13A实物参考图，必须先取得产品实拍或准确模型，不能臆造挂钩、杯架、支架及调节机构的形状和位置。
compliance_note_zh: 文案仅陈述铝合金拉杆、三档调节及可折叠手机支架等已提供事实；不得将整只旅行箱描述为全铝箱，也不得添加承重、耐用测试、手机兼容范围、认证或绝对化性能。四个侧挂钩与可折叠水杯架须按实物呈现，不使用竞品商标、评分、促销信息或虚构结构。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium, photorealistic detail module for the YWJ model 13A travel suitcase, using the supplied product reference as the sole authority for shape, component placement, color, and construction. Desktop square composition, 2000×2000: reserve a clean empty copy area on the left at normalized coordinates [0.05, 0.10, 0.38, 0.80]; place the suitcase on the right at [0.49, 0.08, 0.46, 0.84]. Show the suitcase from a rear-side three-quarter angle with the aluminum-alloy telescopic handle raised as the primary focal point. Include realistic close-up evidence of the handle’s three adjustment positions through three compact sequential detail views, plus a separate macro view of the integrated foldable phone holder opened on the handle. Following the exact physical reference, clearly reveal all four side hanging hooks and the foldable cup holder in its open position as secondary details. Preserve the authentic vertical shell ribbing, corner protectors, frame, finishes, and proportions. Use soft natural side light, restrained European travel photography, a subtly blurred modern airport or hotel setting, low-saturation gunmetal, silver-gray, navy, and warm neutral tones, crisp metal highlights, and realistic shadows. Use thin leader lines or frameless circular magnification areas without labels. For the mobile 1200×1200 adaptation, place the product and detail views in the upper region [0.08, 0.05, 0.84, 0.53] and preserve an uncluttered blank copy region below at [0.05, 0.64, 0.90, 0.31]. Do not invent hidden mechanisms, alloy grades, load capacities, phone compatibility, dimensions, tests, or certifications. NO rendered text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, badges, icons, promotional graphics, or watermarks.
